$comment: Declarative, machine-consumable manifest for M08 lecture 8.F. The single source of truth that scripts/gen-framework.mjs compiles into a page object, fixtures, a seed spec, and journey specs under examples/m08-manifest/generated/. Steps and assertions are STRUCTURED (not prose) so generation is deterministic. Regenerate with `npm run gen:framework`; never hand-edit the output.

player.note: no semantic role; the video element is the player surface

actions.name: openLiveTv
actions.step: open Live TV from the home menubar

actions.name: openChannel
actions.step: click the channel row at the given index

journeys.requirement: Live TV is reachable from the home page
journeys.risk: Users cannot find Live TV -> lost live-ad revenue
journeys.evidence: URL matches /live and the category nav stays visible

journeys.requirement: Channel guide displays current channel listings
journeys.risk: Empty or short guide -> viewers see no channels to watch
journeys.evidence: at least 10 channelRows visible after the guide loads

journeys.requirement: Clicking a channel opens the player
journeys.risk: Channel click dead-ends -> no playback, core product failure
journeys.evidence: URL matches /live/<id> and the video element is visible

seed.note: Anonymous Live TV browse needs no data seeding; the seed asserts the anchor site is reachable before the journey suite runs. Excluded from normal runs via testIgnore ['**/seed.spec.ts'].
